scope: Independent source inspection and original-DAT endpoint comparison of dat.py and cli.py; no electrical findings assessed.
implementation_state: Working-tree implementation after minimal fixes for PARSER-01 through PARSER-03; independently retested.
method: Independent line-record scanner over original source files, separate from production Reader/DatGraph. Compare ordinary (full_net_path, ref, physical_pin) multisets, NC-exported and NC_PINS sets, all physical pins and library labels. Synthetic tests modify strings in memory and intercept file reads; source files were not changed.

review_notes: No automatic voltage, package-based pin pruning, DNP removal, or device conduction model was found in dat.py. Unknown external pins are retained in boundary output.
NC export records are retained separately and not made conductive; two NC_PINS antenna pins remain present.
The current source has only single-number PIN_NUMBER and section 1. Passing this board does not validate multi-section or multi-number mappings.
The calculation evaluator trusts caller-supplied source and operating-mode validity; arithmetic success is not an electrical proof. Candidate verification remains required.

retest.scope: Exact replay of the three reported in-memory defect cases plus original source-copy, endpoint/NC/physical-pin equality and prior pagination/boundary checks. No wider speculative test expansion.
